last.minutes: We maintain our disciplined stance in a neutral, choppy market by keeping our core spot holdings in Bitcoin and Solana while avoiding new coin additions like ADA to prevent high transaction fees and tax drag. The futures book remains strictly flat to protect capital from elevated funding rates and long crowding risks. This patient approach avoids costly churn and preserves dry powder until clearer market trends emerge.

futures.why: Keeping futures flat to avoid high funding rates and long crowding risks in a neutral market.

spot.why: Retaining core Bitcoin holding supported by steady institutional ETF inflows.
Maintaining established Solana position while avoiding unnecessary churn.
